title: ProjectImageCacheService
responsibility: Read and cache committed project images without returning a stale project session response.

inputs.name: ProjectImageCacheService.read.input
inputs.description: Optional project identity and required entityId, commit, version and sha256; an optional option binds the image to that exact design choice.

outputs.name: ProjectImageCacheService.read
outputs.description: Binds the request to the selected project, validates the entity, version, image hash and optional option, and uses a cache identity derived from that captured project. Rechecks the selected project services after asynchronous reads and before returning bytes or beginning a cache write. A cache write already in progress remains keyed to its original project and the response is rechecked afterward.

errors.name: Changed project session
errors.description: Rejects if the selected project or its services differ at a recheck; no stale bytes are returned in that case. A switch away and back between rechecks cannot be independently observed.
